item_short_desc: Rothco’s Large Ultra-Lite Digital Woodland Net is designed for seamless outdoor concealment. Featuring a 3-D digital disruptive pattern that mimics natural foliage, this net blends effortlessly into wooded or grassy environments. Its UV-treated, waterproof nylon rip-stop material ensures long-lasting durability against harsh weather. The lightweight construction makes it easy to carry, fold, and deploy, while its flexibility allows for use in extreme temperature conditions.
description: Rothco’s Large Ultra-Lite Digital Woodland Net is designed for seamless outdoor concealment. Featuring a 3-D digital disruptive pattern that mimics natural foliage, this net blends effortlessly into wooded or grassy environments. Its UV-treated, waterproof nylon rip-stop material ensures long-lasting durability against harsh weather. The lightweight construction makes it easy to carry, fold, and deploy, while its flexibility allows for use in extreme temperature conditions. Whether for hunting, outdoor photography, or themed décor, this net is a versatile addition to your outdoor gear. Measuring 7 foot 10 inch x 19 foot 8 inch, it provides ample coverage while remaining hassle-free. Note: Not fire retardant, recommended for outdoor use only.
